audit.definition: Climactic Mazama airborne bulk fallout. 31 point values, 137 lower limits and 103 upper limits are shared by all five families. Core duplicates and inferred phase totals carry explicit qualifications. The current input incorporates the published Yellowstone core data, Lyman Lake and the Ruby Mountain, Great Salt Lake, Mazama source and thicknessless-site reviews, Young’s separately mapped upper pumice sections, the Round Meadow borings, North Cascades and British Columbia lake cores, northern Idaho lake packages, Mount Baker field sections and the distal deposit-nature revision. Bounds and sensitivity alternatives are in the locality ledger.

buffer_rule.rule: Median nearest-distinct-site distance; halve to 1/2, 1/4, then zero only if an inner training set lacks six exact values/four distinct non-collinear sites.
buffer_rule.uses: Coordinates and observation kinds only; never thickness values.
